value.hook: Open before gating an action (not a brake) on a cache/liveness/session fact, adding a pij line to a skill route or template, or when shared-build has queued you for over 20 minutes
value.title: Act only on known state, route lines are tested commands, and beating the build lock (F152, plan 225)

sections.name: body
sections.value:
1. A brake may treat unknown as "allow"; an action may not. The cold-wake guard can only refuse, so unknown facts let a send through (`is_known_warm` is false on unknown). `revive --cheap` is an action gated on "cold", so reusing `!is_known_warm` let an unknown state relaunch a seat (spoonbill BLOCK on #207). Ask what the gate does if it can't tell: an action needs positive evidence. Use `pij_core::cold_wake::cache_known(block, now)`: `Ok(true)` warm, `Ok(false)` cold, `Err(reason)` from a closed vocabulary. Refuse on `Err` and name the reason. `is_warm` is built on it, so warm has one definition.

2. Every `pij <verb> ...` line in `skills/pij/references/routes/community.md` and the role templates is a tested command. `crates/cli/tests/skill_verb_coverage.rs::the_community_route_and_templates_print_real_commands` parses each one (fenced blocks and inline backticks) against the leaf's `--help`, so a missing required flag fails. For example, `directory edit` requires `--set` in its usage line. `pij-rs ...` lines aren't scanned. Run that test before pushing any route edit.

3. Shared build lock starvation. `just shared-build` polls an mkdir lock with no queue. Under fleet load (load average 20-30) I waited 40+ minutes. With disk free (`df -g ~`, floor 25 GB), point the same recipe at a worktree-own target: `PIJ_SHARED_TARGET=<worktree>/target CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 nice -n 19 just shared-build -- ...`. That keeps the lock and disk-floor semantics. Delete the target with the worktree after merge (about 3 GB).

4. Revive facts (plan 225): revive only relaunches stopped seats (tombstoned, or observed dead with the pane absent). pij never kills a live seat. `revive --model <id>` and `--cheap` (Sonnet 5.5, waits for registration, then sends the ordinary compact control from the CLI) reuse the shared launch path. A Claude seat's recorded model is its launch `--model`, so the spawn wait's `requested_model_matches` is the boundModel proof. Never `/model` in a pane.

5. CI: `crates/tmux/tests/adapter.rs::ownership_tokens_do_not_recycle_across_adapters` can fail with "failed to tear down isolated tmux server ... server exited unexpectedly". It's a teardown flake. If your PR doesn't touch crates/tmux and main is green, run `gh run rerun <id> --failed`.

6. C34 wind-up: at most two rounds, and mutants are optional. Already-run mutation receipts are still worth listing, and say "none unrun" in Known limits when a pm asks you to stop them.
